visualStyle: pencil/cross-hatched manga with restrained warm bronze and ivory

recommendedRuntime.base: Render background + transparent keeper layer continuously; keep playable cards as real DOM/SVG elements.
recommendedRuntime.idleMotion: Finite CSS/parallax only: subtle 2-5px breathing/settle, slow hair/sleeve drift, book-light pulse. No gameplay authority.
recommendedRuntime.reactionOverlays: Use reveal/match/mismatch/streak illustrations as short cross-faded presentation overlays, then return to the layered base scene.
recommendedRuntime.clearFail: Use clear/fail as dedicated cinematic splash states before/with results handoff.
recommendedRuntime.reducedMotion: Disable drift/parallax and use direct opacity/state changes while retaining equivalent visual feedback.
